title: The wajib parts of Salah
intro: The wajibs make our Salah complete; if we forget one, we make sajdat as-sahw.

learn.html: The wajibs of Salah are parts we do so that our Salah is complete. Leaving out a wajib makes the Salah incomplete, and we must make sajdat as-sahw if it happened because we forgot or made a mistake.

items: in the first two rak‘ahs of a fard, and in every rak‘ah of other prayers, reciting a surah or part of the Qur’an after Al-Fatiha – one long or three short ayahs
when praying behind an imam, reciting nothing except Subhanaka in the first rak‘ah
the imam reciting Al-Fatiha and the surah quietly in Dhuhr and Asr and in daytime nafl prayers
the imam reciting Al-Fatiha and the surah aloud in the fard of Fajr, the first two rak‘ahs of Maghrib and Isha, Jumu‘ah, Eid, tarawih and witr in Ramadan
in sajdah, putting the forehead and nose on the ground so we feel it is firm
sitting the first time after the second rak‘ah, long enough to recite At-Tahiyyat
after At-Tahiyyat, standing up for the third rak‘ah
reciting the Qunut dua in witr
ending with the salam: turning the head to the right saying as-salaamu ‘alaykum wa rahmatullaah, then to the left saying the same
saying the six extra takbirs in the Eid prayers
praying with ta‘dil al-arkan – calmly and properly
making sajdat as-sahw when it is needed

learn.html: When we pray behind an imam and he misses a wajib by forgetting or by mistake, he makes sajdat as-sahw at the end, and we as muqtadis make it with him.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: For our Salah to be complete, we must do all the wajibs. Whoever forgets more than three wajibs, or leaves a wajib out on purpose, must repeat the Salah.

practice.title: Aloud or quietly?
practice.prompt: Does the imam recite aloud or quietly in this prayer?

practice.title: Which are wajibs?
practice.prompt: Tap every wajib of Salah, then tap Check.

options.text: The first sitting after the second rak‘ah

options.why: The opening takbir is a fard of Salah, not a wajib.
Ruku‘ is a fard of Salah.

questions.q: What happens if we forget a wajib?
options: The Salah is fine as it is

questions.q: What do we recite behind an imam?
options: Only Subhanaka in the first rak‘ah
Nothing at all, not even Subhanaka

questions.q: How much do we recite after Al-Fatiha, at least?
options: One long or three short ayahs

questions.q: We forget the first sitting and stand up for the 3rd rak‘ah. What do we do?
options: Continue and make sajdat as-sahw at the end
Start again from the beginning right away

questions.q: When must we repeat the Salah?
options: If we leave out a wajib on purpose, or forget more than three

practice.title: Questions and tasks
prompts: 💬 What are the wajibs of Salah? Name them!
🤔 After Salah, someone is sure they prayed fewer rak‘ahs than they should. What should they do?
📋 Make a table: the wajibs in qiyam, in ruku‘, and in the other parts of Salah.
